abstract: The remission rates of 373 patients with trophoblastic diseases were analysed according to the change in therapeutic methods. The following results were obtained. 1) In patients in the "low risk" and nonmetastatic "high risk" group, the remission rate was 100%. On the other hand, in those in the metastatic "high risk" group, the remission rate was only 71.4%, even if triple chemotherapy with methotrexate (MTX), actinomycin D (Act-D) and cyclophosphamide (CPM) was given primarily or secondarily. 2) Thirty-two of the patients in the metastatic "high risk" group underwent primary triple chemotherapy. Eleven additional patients in the same group who had never responded to initial chemotherapy of a different regimen had triple chemotherapy. The overall remission rates were 65.6% (21/32) and 45.5% (5/11), respectively. 3) The remission rate in those with recurrence who underwent triple chemotherapy was 44.4% (4/9). But two of these patients had a re-relapse. 4) Six of the patients in the metastatic "high risk" group had MEA protocol with a moderate dose of MTX, Act-D and etoposide. Five of them achieved remission. 5) The side effects of MEA protocol were not so serious, although alopecia and severe anemia were found in 100% and 75.8% of the patients, respectively.
abstract_ja: 絨毛性疾患373例の寛解率を治療法の変更に応じて解析した。結果は以下のとおりであった。1)「低リスク」群および非転移性「高リスク」群では寛解率は100%であった。一方、転移性「高リスク」群では、メトトレキサート(MTX)、アクチノマイシンD(Act-D)、シクロホスファミド(CPM)による3剤併用化学療法を初回または二次治療として行っても、寛解率は71.4%にとどまった。2)転移性「高リスク」群の32例は初回から3剤併用化学療法を受けた。同群で、別レジメンの初回治療に無効であった11例が追加で3剤併用化学療法を受けた。全体の寛解率はそれぞれ65.6%(21/32)および45.5%(5/11)であった。3)再発例で3剤併用化学療法を受けた症例の寛解率は44.4%(4/9)であった。ただし、このうち2例は再再発した。4)転移性「高リスク」群の6例は、中等量のMTX、Act-D、エトポシドによるMEA療法を受けた。5例で寛解が得られた。5)MEA療法の副作用は重篤ではなかったが、脱毛および重度の貧血がそれぞれ100%、75.8%の患者でみられた。
